title: Zoomex Launches ZWTC 2026 Multi-Asset Trading Championship With a Record Prize Pool of Up to 5 Million USDT
summary: Returning for its third year, Zoomex’s flagship global trading competition expands across crypto perpetuals, stock contracts, AI-powered trading, team competition, and interactive rewards Global, 10 September 2026 — Zoomex, a global cryptocurrency trading platform focused on derivatives, has announced the launch of the Zoomex World Trading Championship 2026 (ZWTC 2026). Returning for its third year, the flagship competition features a total prize pool of up to 5,000,000 USDT, the largest announced in ZWTC history. ZWTC 2026 introduces an expanded multi-asset competition format built around three participation areas: the Team Competition, the Solo Battle, and the Rewards Zone. Across these areas, participants can compete through crypto perpetual contracts, stock contracts, AI-powered trading challenges, team performance leaderboards, and interactive reward activities. The expanded format reflects Zoomex’s product strategy of keeping derivatives at the core while extending access to a broader range of markets, trading tools, and participation models. Rather than focusing on a single asset class or ranking metric, ZWTC 2026 gives traders multiple ways to compete based on their preferred markets, strategies, and levels of participation. “ZWTC 2026 represents more than an increase in prize pool size. This year, we have designed the competition around the markets, tools, and trading formats that participants are actively exploring,” said Fernando Lillo, Marketing Director at Zoomex. “Derivatives remain at the center of Zoomex, while stock contracts, AI-powered trading, and team-based competition allow us to create a more diverse championship for different types of traders.” Three Competition Areas, Up to 5 Million USDT in Rewards ZWTC 2026 allocates its prize pool across three main areas: Competition Area Prize Pool Main Formats Team Competition Up to 2,500,000 USDT Team ROI Leaderboard, Team Trading Volume Leaderboard, Most Popular Team Leaderboard Solo Battle Up to 1,000,000 USDT AI Trading Battle, Stock Contract Profit Leaderboard, Perpetual Contract Trading Volume Leaderboard Rewards Zone Up to 1,500,000 USDT Lucky Wheel, Card Collection and Combination, Daily Check-ins, Missions and Referral Rewards Total Up to 5,000,000 USDT Subject to eligibility requirements, prize-pool activation conditions, and official campaign rules Team Competition: Trading Performance Meets Community Leadership The ZWTC 2026 Team Competition features a prize pool of up to 2,500,000 USDT and includes three separate leaderboards: Team ROI Leaderboard Team Trading Volume Leaderboard Most Popular Team Leaderboard The format is designed to recognize both trading performance and team leadership. Captains are responsible for forming teams, mobilizing their communities, and coordinating participation throughout the competition. Eligible captains may receive a 20% captain’s share of their team’s rewards, while team members can share rewards based on team rankings, individual performance, and the applicable competition rules. Team Competition Schedule Stage Date and Time Captain Recruitment Open now until September 21, 2026, at 10:00 UTC Team Registration September 13, 2026, at 10:00 UTC to October 3, 2026, at 10:00 UTC Team Competition September 21, 2026, at 10:00 UTC to October 11, 2026, at 10:00 UTC By combining ROI, trading volume, and community popularity rankings, the Team Competition provides different paths for teams to demonstrate performance, participation, and influence. Solo Battle: AI, Stock Contracts, and Crypto Perpetuals The Solo Battle offers a prize pool of up to 1,000,000 USDT across three independent competitions: AI Trading Battle Stock Contract Profit Leaderboard Perpetual Contract Trading Volume Leaderboard The top 100 eligible participants on each leaderboard will have the opportunity to receive rewards under the relevant competition rules. The three categories reflect different approaches to derivatives trading. Participants can compete through AI-assisted trading, performance in stock-linked contracts, or trading activity in crypto perpetual contracts. Solo Battle Schedule Stage Date and Time Solo Battle Registration October 10, 2026, at 10:00 UTC to October 23, 2026, at 10:00 UTC Solo Battle Competition October 13, 2026, at 10:00 UTC to October 28, 2026, at 10:00 UTC The multi-category structure allows participants to select a competition based on the market, tool, or trading format most relevant to them. Rewards Zone: More Ways to Participate In addition to the main trading leaderboards, ZWTC 2026 includes a Rewards Zone with a prize pool of up to 1,500,000 USDT. Users can earn participation opportunities by completing eligible activities, including daily check-ins, designated missions, and friend referrals. The Rewards Zone includes: A Lucky Wheel with a reward for every eligible spin Card collection and card-combination activities Daily check-in rewards Mission-based participation opportunities Referral-related rewards Participants who collect and combine designated cards may unlock upgraded rewards. An eligible individual user may have the opportunity to receive rewards worth up to 10,000 USDT, subject to the official campaign rules and availability. The Rewards Zone provides a lower-barrier participation format for users who may not wish to compete directly on a trading leaderboard. A Multi-Asset Evolution of Zoomex’s Flagship Competition ZWTC has developed into one of Zoomex’s core annual brand and community initiatives, connecting trading competition, product use, and global user participation. For 2026, the championship has been expanded to better reflect how traders engage with a broader range of markets and tools. Crypto perpetual contracts remain a central part of the event, while stock contracts and AI-powered trading introduce additional ways for users to test strategies and compete. This multi-asset direction supports Zoomex’s broader strategy of being derivatives-first while expanding the surrounding trading ecosystem. The objective is not to move away from derivatives, but to offer more underlying markets, decision-making tools, and participation formats within a derivatives-led experience. From team collaboration and community leadership to independent trading and AI-supported competition, ZWTC 2026 is structured to accommodate different trading styles and levels of experience. How to Participate Users can participate by: Registering or logging in to a Zoomex account. Visiting the official ZWTC 2026 campaign page. Selecting the Team Competition, Solo Battle, or Rewards Zone. Completing the applicable registration, eligibility, and participation requirements. Eligible users may participate in more than one competition area, subject to the official terms and conditions for each category. ZWTC 2026 Official Campaign Page   About ZOOMEX Founded in 2021, Zoomex is a global cryptocurrency trading platform focused on derivatives trading, serving over 3 million users across 35+ countries and regions and offering 700+ trading pairs. Built around simple usability, transparent rules, fair execution, and a refined trading experience, Zoomex provides users with clear asset and order visibility, transparent fee and rule information, and a high-performance trading environment designed for active crypto traders. Zoomex continues to strengthen its trust framework through Proof of Reserves, Security & Transparency, Compliance Information, and Fees / Rules Transparency initiatives, and has completed security audits conducted by blockchain security firm Hacken. Zoomex holds multiple regulatory licenses, including U.S. and Canada MSB, U.S. NFA, and Australia AUSTRAC, supporting its commitment to a clearer, more transparent, and rule-based trading experience. At Zoomex: Easy to Use. Transparent balance. Fair access to your earnings.

title: BVNK and Marqeta Partner to Power Stablecoin-Card Infrastructure
summary:
BVNK and Marqeta, Inc. today announced a partnership to deliver stablecoin-backed card capabilities to crypto-native and non-crypto companies. The integration will enable Marqeta’s customers to embed stablecoin capabilities into wallets, cards and everyday financial products. Together, the companies are unlocking stablecoin spendability to allow users to transact in digital dollars at millions of merchants globally with a standard payment card.
Marqeta, the modern card issuing platform provider, processed nearly $400 billion in annual payments volume during 2025, demonstrating the depth and scale of its offering. BVNK is the stablecoin payments infrastructure provider behind more than $39 billion in annualized payment volume, helping enterprises move digital dollars globally.
The partnership is noteworthy as it connects Marqeta with two existing parts of Mastercard's network. Mastercard is one of Marqeta’s major network partners, while BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure has been part of Mastercard since its acquisition of the business in August 2026. Over time, the growing collaboration will give Marqeta's customers a path to additional Mastercard capabilities through the same integration, rather than a separate build.
Mastercard, Marqeta and BVNK are also all supporters of Open USD, a global standard for stablecoins that is collaborative, transparent and built to scale. By bringing together companies across the payments ecosystem around a common standard, Open USD will help create a shared foundation for stablecoin payments that works across networks, providers and use cases, making it easier to adopt digital dollars and scale them across payment operations.
The partnership reflects growing demand for stablecoin wallets inside mainstream financial products. Earlier this year, BVNK research found that 77% of surveyed crypto holders would open a stablecoin wallet through their primary bank or fintech app if one were available. The partnership gives Marqeta customers access to stablecoin infrastructure without having to build and operate it themselves. This can be even more powerful with attached card credentials that allow users to spend wherever Mastercard is accepted.
“Stablecoins are becoming a durable, complementary layer in global money movement, particularly where speed and cost matter most. The real question is how you incorporate them into the infrastructure people and businesses already trust,” said Anthony Peculic, Chief Strategy Officer at Marqeta. “By collaborating with Mastercard and BVNK we're enabling our customers to issue stablecoin-backed cards that work anywhere cards are accepted, without requiring merchants to change how they accept payments. This partnership further strengthens Marqeta’s leadership at the intersection of crypto and fiat payments, and our ability to deliver flexible solutions to both crypto-native and non-crypto companies.”
BVNK will provide the infrastructure for Marqeta’s customers to move and manage stablecoins alongside traditional fiat currencies through familiar financial products, while Marqeta will manage card issuance, acceptance and bank and network relationships. Marqeta selected BVNK's regulated platform to accelerate delivery while maintaining the compliance and operational standards expected by enterprise customers.
“As more financial products become global by default, businesses need infrastructure that lets money move as quickly as information. Stablecoins are becoming part of the core payments infrastructure, and we are excited to help bring these capabilities to Marqeta’s customers,” said Chris Harmse, Co-Founder and Chief Business Officer at BVNK. “Stablecoins are another financial building block. Developers shouldn't need deep blockchain expertise to use them any more than they understand card networks today. Our role is to make that infrastructure invisible, and doing that from inside Mastercard's network, alongside a partner like Marqeta who's been building on it for years, is exactly the kind of connection we exist to make.”
The partnership is another sign that stablecoins are moving beyond crypto-native applications and into the infrastructure powering global financial services. As stablecoin networks mature, they are becoming another payments rail alongside cards and bank transfers. 
Marqeta and BVNK will speak about stablecoin-backed cards and how the partnership is bringing value to the ecosystem today at Stablecon, the world’s leading stablecoin conference, in Washington DC. Find more information here.
NoYesPayments10 Sep, 2026
content: BVNK and Marqeta have announced a partnership to deliver stablecoin-backed card infrastructure for companies globally. The collaboration enables Marqeta customers to embed stablecoin capabilities into everyday financial products, allowing users to transact with digital dollars at millions of merchants. The initiative connects both companies within the broader Mastercard network, aiming to bridge traditional fiat payments with growing demand for stablecoin solutions.

title: FinXP Partners With Thredd to Strengthen Multi-Region Card Issuing Capabilities
summary:
New partnership combines FinXP’s Mastercard principal membership and issuing capabilities with Thredd’s issuer-processing platform to support scalable debit card programmes across Europe and future growth markets.
FinXP has partnered with global issuer-processing platform Thredd to strengthen our card issuing capabilities and support the next phase of our embedded finance offering.
The partnership will give FinXP access to a modern issuer-processing stack supporting areas including tokenisation, provisioning, risk and fraud prevention, card controls and automated back-office operations.
FinXP will continue to control its own ledger and programme strategy, while Thredd will provide the processing infrastructure and operational support required to help us build secure, flexible and scalable card programmes across multiple regions.
Building on five years of card issuing
FinXP has been issuing cards for five years and is a principal member of Mastercard.
Card issuing forms part of our wider payments infrastructure offering, alongside dedicated IBAN accounts, SEPA Instant payments, SEPA Direct Debit collections, global payouts, and embedded finance capabilities.
The partnership with Thredd represents another step in our strategy to provide fintechs, platforms, and internationally active businesses with regulated payment infrastructure that can support increasingly sophisticated use cases.
“Card issuing is an important part of FinXP’s broader embedded finance strategy,” said Jens Podewski, co-founder and CEO of FinXP.
“As a Mastercard principal member, we already have the issuing foundation in place. This new partnership gives us the processing infrastructure and operational support to take our capabilities further, support more complex use cases, and expand into new markets with greater confidence.”
Supporting FinXP’s next phase of growth
FinXP selected Thredd following a competitive review process, with its technical capabilities, responsiveness and willingness to develop a solution around FinXP’s operating model playing an important role in the decision.
Thredd provides issuer-processing technology to more than 100 fintechs, digital banks and embedded finance providers across over 50 countries.
“Payment companies today are looking for partners that can move quickly without sacrificing control, compliance or customisation,” said Jim McCarthy, CEO at Thredd.
“That is exactly where Thredd is focused: helping regulated institutions and fintechs bring differentiated payment products to market with the infrastructure, controls and support to scale.”
The partnership also creates opportunities beyond FinXP’s own card programmes. FinXP will be able to act as a European BIN sponsor for Thredd’s global client base, supporting Thredd’s partner-led approach to serving clients across multiple geographies.
For FinXP, this expands the role we can play within the wider card issuing ecosystem while strengthening our ability to support businesses looking to launch and scale payment products in Europe.

content: FinXP has partnered with issuer-processing platform Thredd to enhance its multi-region card issuing capabilities. The collaboration combines FinXP's Mastercard principal membership with Thredd's technology stack, including tokenisation and fraud prevention, to support scalable debit card programmes across Europe and future growth markets. Additionally, FinXP plans to serve as a European BIN sponsor for Thredd's global clients.

title: Stripe Helps Muse, Meta’s New Personal AI Agent, Shop Across the Internet With Link
summary:
Stripe, the programmable financial services company, today announced that Meta has integrated Link’s wallet for agents with Muse, its new personal AI agent. US consumers can connect their Link accounts to Muse and enable their muse agent to buy from businesses across the internet.
Agents have become capable of increasingly complex tasks in recent months, but making purchases remains difficult. Ecommerce was built for people. People browse websites, compare prices, enter cards, and complete checkout flows. For agents to become economic actors, they need to be able to navigate the internet as people do, and they need to be equipped with the payment options businesses and consumers use today. That’s where Link, Stripe’s consumer network with over 300 million users globally, comes in. Earlier this year, Stripe introduced Link's wallet for agents, which gives agents the ability to spend across the internet on behalf of consumers. Now, Meta is bringing that experience to Muse.
At more than 1 million businesses that accept Link, Muse can check out instantly using a US consumer’s preferred payment method saved in Link. This helps businesses benefit from Link’s higher conversion and authorization rates. For other businesses, Link issues Muse a single-use virtual card scoped to the approved purchase. For every purchase, consumers are asked to approve the transaction total directly in the chat interface, and Muse never sees their underlying payment details.
“Stripe is building the infrastructure that lets agents buy from businesses,” said Jay Shah, business lead for Link at Stripe. “By equipping Muse with Link’s wallet for agents, Meta is helping more consumers experience the magic of having an agent shop on their behalf.”
This follows Stripe’s recent announcements that Link agent wallet helps power payments for Grok Bot and Instinct. Stripe is building the economic infrastructure for AI. That includes empowering agents to transact on behalf of consumers, and helping businesses accept payments from agents with confidence.
NoYesArtificial Intelligence10 Sep, 2026
content: Stripe has announced that Meta has integrated Link's wallet for agents with Muse, its new personal AI agent. US consumers can now connect their Link accounts to Muse, allowing the AI to make purchases across the internet on their behalf. Transactions are approved directly within the chat interface, and consumers' underlying payment details are kept secure.

title: First Pilot BLIK Transaction Completed Independently by an AI Agent
summary:
For the first time, an AI agent independently completed a purchase and paid for it using BLIK, without the user’s involvement at the moment of the transaction. As part of the pilot project, the agent monitored the availability of a product specified by the user during a conversation with an AI assistant in the Your KAYA online store. When the selected product variant – a “light hand cream with coconut and almond fragrance” – became available again, the agent made the purchase. The PLN 19.99 transaction was carried out based on a prior instruction given to the agent, confirmed by entering a six-digit BLIK code and approving it in the user’s banking app. Juo was responsible for enabling the AI agent chat in store, while the payment was processed by PayU.
The autonomous BLIK payment pilot demonstrates that AI agents can securely use BLIK to make purchases on behalf of users, within boundaries defined by them in advance. It also confirms that the technology across every stage of the process –  from AI infrastructure, through the merchant environment and payment processing, to the payment method itself – is ready today to support systems capable of completing purchases without the consumer’s direct involvement.
Monika Król, Vice President of BLIK:


"The market is seeing a growing number of solutions capable of finding products, comparing offers and recommending the best way to buy. Until now, payment has been the missing element in this process. Our solution completes the model: an agent can take over the entire purchasing journey, from monitoring an offer to finalising the transaction with BLIK. However, it operates exclusively within boundaries previously defined by the user and cannot complete a transaction without the user’s prior authorisation emphasises Monika Król, Vice President of BLIK.


For us, however, the significance of this pilot goes far beyond the agent’s ability to make a payment. It is a test of whether Poland’s payment infrastructure – available today in virtually every banking app and accepted by thousands of online stores – can become the foundation of an entirely new purchasing model. Agentic commerce changes the definition of who the buyer is, and the payment systems that succeed will be those that are ready for this shift before it becomes a market standard. We want BLIK to be one of them"


From product monitoring to autonomous purchasing
In traditional e-commerce, users independently move through each stage of the purchasing journey – searching for a product, checking its availability, adding it to the basket, selecting a payment method and authorizing the transaction. In commerce involving AI agents, some of these activities can be delegated to technology. An agent can help identify suitable products, but it can also complete a purchase according to the model selected by the user – whether as a one-off transaction carried out immediately with the customer’s involvement, a one-off transaction executed at a later time on the customer’s instruction (for example, when a size is unavailable, an item is out of stock or delivery needs to be postponed), or as an instruction for subscription of selected products.
Agentic commerce will not transform retail simply because an agent is able to buy something. The real change will begin when it understands the customer’s context, the relationship with the merchant, the user’s consents and the way payments are executed. At Juo, from the very beginning, we have been building technology with a full understanding of the long-term customer relationship. That is why this pilot is so important to us: it shows not only the future of payments, but also what subscriptions could look like in the world of agentic commerce


- says Leszek Zawadzki, CEO of Juo.
In the pilot, a logged-in user initiated the process through a chat conversation and assigned tasks to the AI agent. Its objective was to monitor the availability of a hand cream whose selected variant was sold out at the time. The agent continuously checked the store’s offer, waiting for the specified product to become available again.
A key element of the process was the user’s prior instruction authorizing the agent to complete the purchase and execute the payment. The user granted payment consent in their banking app, defining the conditions under which the agent could continue acting on their behalf.
The first payment completed by an AI agent without the user’s direct involvement confirms that agentic commerce is moving beyond the conceptual stage and is becoming a real purchasing scenario. Crucially, however, agent autonomy does not mean that consumers lose control – the agent operates within the limits of previously granted payment consent, defined spending limits and clearly specified conditions. At PayU, we are committed to developing solutions that will allow agent-driven purchases to scale responsibly, because their success will depend not only on technology, but above all on customer trust


- says Katarzyna Prus-Malinowska, Head of Product Management at PayU.
When the product became available again, the AI agent detected its availability, added the previously specified variant to the basket and independently completed the entire process. The PLN 19.99 purchase was paid for using BLIK. At the moment the transaction was finalised, no additional action was required from the user – the agent acted autonomously within the boundaries of the payment consent previously granted in the banking app.
Whenever a technology emerges that can make shopping more convenient for our customers, we want to be among the first to test it. That was the case with subscriptions paid for using BLIK recurring payments. Today, together with Juo, BLIK and PayU, we are the first in Poland to open the chapter of agentic commerce: shopping experiences in which customers are supported by an intelligent assistant


- says Dawid Zimny, Head of Growth & eCommerce at Your KAYA.

title: Ripple Treasury Launches AI Agents That Cite Policy and Wait for Approval
summary:
Today, Ripple announced a major expansion of GSmart, the treasury-native AI capabilities built into Ripple Treasury. Already in production across its enterprise customer base, GSmart embeds AI directly into the policies, data, and workflows treasury teams use every day. This expansion adds new policy-governed capabilities across forecasting, liquidity, risk, reconciliation, and reporting, helping finance teams make faster, more informed decisions while maintaining the controls and auditability required by enterprise organizations.
Enterprise adoption of AI agents is accelerating faster than the governance around it. Gartner projects that the average Fortune 500 company could have more than 150,000 agents in use by 2028, while just 13 percent of organizations believe they have the right AI agent governance in place today. For treasury teams responsible for critical financial operations, that governance gap raises the stakes for how and where AI is deployed.
GSmart is specifically designed to solve that gap by separating financial calculation from AI interpretation. Deterministic engines perform the calculations behind financial decisions, while AI is used to interpret policy, identify patterns, and explain recommendations. Treasury teams retain approval authority over every financial action.
"Every CFO is under pressure to embrace AI, but they're equally responsible for ensuring every financial decision is explainable, governed and compliant," said Renaat Ver Eecke, SVP of Ripple Treasury. "Rather than asking customers to blindly trust an AI system, GSmart works within each organization's own treasury policies to surface recommendations transparently, while ensuring humans remain in control of every decision. This isn't simply AI-native treasury, but rather treasury-native AI."
The launch includes a broad suite of AI capabilities spanning treasury operations, analytics and risk management. Available capabilities include:
Orchestrated agents across forecasting and planning, liquidity, risk, reconciliation and reporting. Each agent monitors its process, proposes a specific action, cites the policy clause behind it, and waits for approval before anything executes.
Knowledge Studio, which serves as the policy and governance layer for GSmart, allowing treasury teams to define organizational policies and controls that guide how AI capabilities operate. All proposed actions are checked against these controls before being up-leveled to a person.
Analytics Studio featuring Ask GSmart, a unified foundation for treasury analytics and AI-powered reporting, with a conversational assistant that helps treasury teams quickly retrieve answers and insights from treasury data.
Ripple Treasury is already seeing adoption of GSmart across its enterprise customer base. 60% of eligible customers have enabled Risk Insights — which surfaces exposure anomalies and policy breaches — and 44% of eligible customers are leveraging Forecast Insights — which compares forecasted and actual cash flows to identify emerging liquidity gaps.
GSmart represents the next step in Ripple Treasury's vision for AI-powered treasury management. With today's announcement, Ripple Treasury is building the end-to-end system corporate treasurers and CFOs need to manage both traditional and digital assets from a single platform. Following the launch of native digital asset capabilities earlier this year, GSmart adds intelligence and predictive insights across the treasury lifecycle. Together, these capabilities give finance teams the ability to view, predict, move and earn on cash and digital asset balances around the world, bringing traditionally fragmented treasury operations into one connected system.

title: The Payments Association Appoints Daniel Jonas as Global Ambassador to Run New Global Payments Infrastructure Working Group
summary:
The Payments Association, a trade body for the payments sector, has appointed Daniel Jonas as its new Global Ambassador, leading a new working group, Global Payments Infrastructure, to build the foundations for safe, resilient and interoperable payments. 
He is a payments infrastructure and innovation strategist, with more than 25 years’ experience advancing from analyst roles to senior innovation leadership at firms like Atkins and Pay.UK. He brings deep expertise in interoperability, trust systems, and next-generation digital infrastructure. 

Daniel Jonas, newly appointed Global Ambassador, said: "Stepping into this role, I'm looking forward to building bridges with UK and international partners across the industry, looking at payments through an international perspective, identifying new opportunities for innovation, growth and co-operation. 
“It's a genuinely exciting time for global collaboration. Over my years in this industry, I've seen how fragmented things can be, different businesses and specialities chasing the same outcome and reinventing the wheel but rarely working together to solve shared global challenges or make use of existing capability or interconnections. What we need is real co-operation across the industry and beyond it so payments infrastructure can realise its unique potential to act as the backbone of the financial and digital world in the era of the “multi-moneyverse.”
“That's exactly what the Global Payments Infrastructure Working Group is focused on. No one country, operator, or technology provider can solve these challenges in isolation. By bringing together the best thinking and hands-on experience from the UK and around the world, we can deliver real benefits for end users, identify the missing pieces of the puzzle and push for a systematic approach to interoperability." 
The Global Payments Infrastructure Working Group was created by The Payments Association to bring together the people who design, operate and regulate payments to help shape the future of its infrastructure as it continues to transform at pace.  
The first output is a report due in early 2027, laying out a common framework, proven global models, existing gaps and practical recommendations for action. The group will also play a role in Payments Week in London in April 2027. 
Fiat money, commercial bank money, stablecoins, tokenised deposits and other digital forms of value increasingly need to coexist and interoperate. The Payments Association understands that this cannot be solved in isolation.  
The working group will provide a neutral, practitioner-led forum to combine practical experience from the UK and around the world, to reuse proven approaches, reduce duplication and identify where common infrastructure can deliver wider benefits. It will examine payments infrastructure as a connected system, covering the legal, regulatory, technical, operational and commercial dependencies needed for solutions to work safely and at scale, allowing money and other forms of value to move safely from end to end. 

Tony Craddock, Founder of The Payments Association, said: “Daniel’s breadth of experience and his global network of relationships with infrastructure experts makes him perfect to lead this new working group. It will be a tough gig, but it’s critical to ensuring we don’t repeat the mistakes of the past: unnecessary duplication, excessive friction and unaffordable cost. Payments users deserve better. 
If anyone can pull together some fresh thinking on payments infrastructure, with all its complexities, vested interests and legacy thinking, Daniel can. The result will be more resilient, interoperable and productive progress in payments infrastructure worldwide.”

content: The Payments Association has appointed Daniel Jonas as its new Global Ambassador. Jonas will lead the newly formed Global Payments Infrastructure Working Group, which aims to build safe, resilient, and interoperable payment systems. The group will examine global payment dependencies and plans to release its first report in early 2027 to address fragmentation and encourage international cooperation across the digital and financial sectors.

title: Lloyds Banking Group Hunts for the UK’s Next Standout Start-Ups and Scale-Ups
summary:
Lloyds Banking Group is inviting ambitious start-ups and scale-ups to pitch technology and solutions that could shape services used by millions of customers.
Successful applicants will work directly with specialists from across the Group, gaining insight into the needs of 28 million retail customers and around one million businesses across banking, mortgages, insurance, investments and motor finance. They will develop and test their ideas against real customer and business challenges, with the strongest propositions potentially progressing to a commercial proof of concept or longer-term partnership.
Four opportunities for founders to solve customer challenges
This year, applicants are being asked to show how their technology could address one of four areas:
Simpler home ownership: Helping people find, buy, manage, improve and protect their homes through better data, personalised support and simpler digital experiences.
Better mortgage broker journeys: Finding ways to cut down on paperwork and other admin by making it easier to collect important information, link systems, automate common tasks and give brokers clearer information, during a mortgage application.
More connected customer services: Helping customers manage travel, motoring, energy bills and more through relevant and convenient digital experiences.
More confident investing: Giving customers clearer guidance, insight and tools to understand what they can afford to invest, find suitable investments and manage their portfolios.
Applications are open to technology businesses and individuals from any sector that can demonstrate a relevant solution, a clear customer benefit and a credible commercial case.
What successful applicants will receive
Selected participants will work with Lloyds Banking Group specialists from mortgages to investments, to develop and test their solution against one of the challenges, while getting valuable insight into customer and business needs.
Ideas will be pitched to the bank’s expert Launch Innovation team, with the strongest ideas potentially progressing to a proof of concept or longer-term collaboration.
Taking part can be a springboard for ambitious people and businesses, helping them sharpen their ideas and build other relationships across Lloyds Banking Group. Relevant applications may also be reviewed by the Group’s Fintech Investment team, with the potential to explore wider opportunities beyond the programme.
 
Launch Innovation participation can lead to longer-term partnerships
 
Previous Launch Innovation participants have gone on to work with Lloyds Banking Group on customer tools and services. Success stories from the programme include:
 

Caura: An all-in-one motoring platform that received a £4 million investment from Lloyds Banking Group and went on to power a white-labelled app for Lex Autolease. The app allows customers to manage their lease, book vehicle maintenance and access new vehicle offers in one place.
 

Planna: A Neighbourhood Guide digital tool, providing local insights on areas including house prices, living costs, transport and schools to support people planning a move.
 

ApTap: A fintech partnership that began with Bill Switcher, helping customers compare and switch household services, and has since expanded to power an offers marketplace where Lloyds customers can access discounts through the Rewards section of the Lloyds app.
 
 
Paul Wilkinson, Rewards and Launch Innovation Director at Lloyds Banking Group, said: “For an ambitious start-up, finding the right entry point into a large financial services group can be challenging. Launch Innovation gives founders a clear route to our specialists, customer insight and the opportunity to test whether their technology can solve a genuine business challenge.
 
“We have seen participants turn that opportunity into investment, customer-facing services and longer-term commercial relationships. We are looking for founders with strong technology, a clear customer benefit and the ambition to take their proposition further.”

EU's restrictive tokenization caps risk stifling innovation and competitiveness, potentially driving financial markets to more flexible US frameworks.
The post Nasdaq, Boerse Stuttgart urge EU to adjust tokenization trial caps appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Major financial institutions including Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart have urged the European Union to remove or increase restrictive caps in its ongoing tokenization trial. Industry leaders warn that current limits could stifle innovation and competitiveness, potentially driving financial markets toward more flexible regulatory frameworks in the United States.
content_ta: Nasdaq மற்றும் Boerse Stuttgart உள்ளிட்ட முக்கிய நிதி நிறுவனங்கள், ஐரோப்பிய ஒன்றியம் தனது tokenization சோதனையில் உள்ள கடுமையான வரம்புகளை நீக்கவோ அல்லது அதிகரிக்கவோ கோரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளன. தற்போதைய கட்டுப்பாடுகள் புதுமை மற்றும் போட்டித்தன்மையை முடக்கிவிடலாம் என்றும், இது நிதிச் சந்தைகளை அமெரிக்காவின் நெகிழ்வான கட்டமைப்புகளுக்குத் தள்ளிவிடக்கூடும் என்றும் துறைசார் தலைவர்கள் எச்சரித்துள்ளனர்.

title: Threatened with arrest online? Recognizing a law enforcement impersonation scam
summary: So-called digital arrest scams use false claims of authority to pressure victims virtually into making rapid digital payments, including cryptocurrency transactions, writes Moody's Rich Graham.
content: Digital arrest scams are an emerging threat where fraudsters impersonate law enforcement online. Using false claims of authority, criminals pressure victims into making rapid digital payments, including cryptocurrency transactions. According to Moody's Rich Graham, these scams rely on psychological pressure and manufactured urgency to force victims into transferring funds before they realize they are being targeted by cybercriminals.
content_ta: டிஜிட்டல் அரெஸ்ட் மோசடிகள் என்பது சட்ட அமலாக்க அதிகாரிகளாக ஆன்லைனில் ஆள்மாறாட்டம் செய்யும் குற்றவாளிகளால் அதிகரிக்கும் அச்சுறுத்தலாகும். அதிகாரப்பூர்வமான போலியான दावங்களைக் கொண்டு, கிரிப்டோகரன்சி பரிவர்த்தனைகள் உள்ளிட்ட அவசர டிஜிட்டல் கட்டணங்களைச் செலுத்த குற்றவாளிகள் பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர்களை வற்புறுத்துகின்றனர். Moody's அமைப்பைச் சேர்ந்த Rich Graham அவர்களின் கூற்றுப்படி, இந்த மோசடிகள் உளவியல் ரீதியான அழுத்தம் மற்றும் அவசர உணர்வை நம்பியே செயல்படுகின்றன.

title: Crypto researchers cut Bitcoin and Ethereum quantum attack estimate by 50%
summary: A paper shared with CoinDesk shows humans and AI agents beating Google’s March result on a core calculation used by Shor’s algorithm, adding another variable to crypto’s quantum clock.
content: Crypto researchers have reduced their estimate for a quantum computing attack on Bitcoin and Ethereum by 50%. A new paper reveals that humans and AI agents have surpassed Google's previous calculation results related to Shor’s algorithm. This development introduces a new variable into the timeline for quantum security threats facing the cryptocurrency industry.
content_ta: Bitcoin மற்றும் Ethereum மீதான குவாண்டம் கம்ப்யூட்டிங் தாக்குதலுக்கான மதிப்பீட்டை கிரிப்டோ ஆராய்ச்சியாளர்கள் 50% வரை குறைத்துள்ளனர். Shor’s algorithm தொடர்பான கூகுளின் முந்தைய கணக்கீட்டு முடிவுகளை மனிதர்களும் AI ஏஜெண்டுகளும் விஞ்சியுள்ளதாக புதிய ஆய்வுக் கட்டுரை ஒன்று வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது. இந்த முன்னேற்றம் கிரிப்டோகரன்சி துறை எதிர்கொள்ளும் குவாண்டம் பாதுகாப்பு அச்சுறுத்தல்களுக்கான காலவரிசையில் புதிய மாற்றத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
summary: Memecoin platform Pump.fun accounted for most of the new tokens among launchpads, as the Solana network notched a new all-time daily issuance high.
content: Solana recently recorded an all-time high of 263,000 tokens issued in a single day. This surge in activity was largely driven by the memecoin platform Pump.fun, which accounted for the majority of the new tokens created among launchpads on the Solana network.
content_ta: Solana நெட்வொர்க்கில் ஒரே நாளில் சாதனை அளவாக 263,000 டோக்கன்கள் வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளதாகத் தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. Pump.fun போன்ற மீம்காயின் பிளாட்ஃபார்ம்கள் மூலம் இந்த புதிய டோக்கன்களின் உருவாக்கம் பெருமளவில் அதிகரித்துள்ளது.

title: Uniswap launches ‘StablePair Hook’ to help LPs capture more stablecoin trading value
summary: Uniswap Labs has launched StablePair Hook, a Uniswap v4 tool that uses dynamic fees for stablecoin pairs such as USDC/USDT.
content: Uniswap Labs has officially launched the 'StablePair Hook,' a new tool designed for the upcoming Uniswap v4 protocol. This feature utilizes dynamic fees specifically tailored for stablecoin trading pairs like USDC and USDT. The innovation aims to help liquidity providers capture more trading value and optimize their returns within the decentralized finance ecosystem.
content_ta: Uniswap v4 புரோட்டோகாலுக்கான புதிய டூலான 'StablePair Hook'-ஐ Uniswap Labs அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. USDC மற்றும் USDT போன்ற ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் ஜோடிகளுக்கு டைனமிக் கட்டணங்களைப் பயன்படுத்தும் வகையில் இந்த அம்சம் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் லிக்விடிட்டி வழங்குநர்கள் அதிக வர்த்தக மதிட்டைப் பெறவும், டெஃபி சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பில் தங்கள் லாபத்தை உகந்ததாக்கவும் இது உதவுகிறது.

title: Researchers halve quantum resource benchmark for key operation in Bitcoin, Ethereum attack
summary: The resulting benchmark is less than half Google's previously reported level, though the two approaches use different accounting methods.
content: Researchers have successfully reduced the quantum resource benchmark for a key operation used in attacks against Bitcoin and Ethereum by more than half. Their new benchmark falls significantly below the previously reported levels established by Google. However, experts note that the two distinct approaches rely on different accounting methods to calculate these computational requirements.
content_ta: Bitcoin மற்றும் Ethereum மீதான தாக்குதல்களுக்குப் பயன்படுத்தப்படும் முக்கிய செயல்பாட்டிற்கான குவாண்டம் வள அளவுகோலை ஆராய்ச்சியாளர்கள் பாதியாகக் குறைத்துள்ளனர். Google நிறுவனத்தால் முன்னர் அறிவிக்கப்பட்ட அளவை விட இந்த புதிய அளவுகோல் பாதியாக உள்ளது. இருப்பினும், இந்த இரண்டு முறைகளும் கணக்கீடுகளுக்கு வெவ்வேறு கணக்கியல் முறைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துவதாக வல்லுநர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: US hit on $24 billion crypto black market sends rival money launderers running for exits
summary:
DOJ seized Telegram channels and two wallets while OFAC sanctioned Xinbi and the developers behind SafeW and XinbiPay.
The post US hit on $24 billion crypto black market sends rival money launderers running for exits appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: The US Department of Justice recently targeted a massive $24 billion cryptocurrency black market, seizing Telegram channels and digital wallets. Simultaneously, the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control imposed sanctions on illicit platforms like Xinbi, SafeW, and XinbiPay. This major enforcement action has caused rival money laundering operations and networks to quickly scramble and flee the market.
content_ta: அமெரிக்காவின் DOJ அமைப்பு 24 பில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்புள்ள கிரிப்டோ கருப்பு சந்தையை குறிவைத்து, Telegram சேனல்கள் மற்றும் டிஜிட்டல் வாலெட்களை முடக்கியது. அதே நேரத்தில், OFAC அமைப்பு Xinbi, SafeW மற்றும் XinbiPay போன்ற தளங்கள் மீது தடை விதித்துள்ளது. இந்த அதிரடி நடவடிக்கையால் மற்ற பணமோசடி நெட்வொர்க்குகள் அதிர்ச்சியடைந்து தலைமறைவாகியுள்ளன.

title: StonkFun overtakes PONS in revenue – Can it become Solana’s next launchpad leader?
summary: Why STONK is still far from flipping PUMP by market cap.
content: StonkFun has recently surpassed PONS in revenue, sparking discussions about whether it can emerge as the next major launchpad leader on Solana. However, industry observers note that STONK still has a long way to go before it can catch up to PUMP in terms of overall market capitalization.
content_ta: StonkFun நிறுவனம் வருவாயில் PONS-ஐ முந்தியுள்ளது, மேலும் இது Solana-வின் அடுத்த முக்கிய launchpad தலைவராக மாற முடியுமா என்ற விவாதங்களை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இருப்பினும், ஒட்டுமொத்த சந்தை மூலதனத்தின் அடிப்படையில் PUMP-ஐ முந்துவதற்கு STONK இன்னும் நீண்ட தூரம் செல்ல வேண்டும் என்று துறைசார் பார்வையாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: SPX6900 drops 10% – Can dip buyers stop SPX’s fall to $0.41?
summary: SPX6900 dropped 10% , breaching the $0.50 and fell to a local low of $0.46 as market sentiment flipped bearish.
content: SPX6900 recently dropped by 10%, breaching the key $0.50 level and reaching a local low of $0.46. As market sentiment shifted toward a bearish outlook, investors and traders are closely watching the charts to see if dip buyers can step in and halt further downward movement toward the $0.41 support area.
content_ta: SPX6900 விலை சமீபத்தில் 10 சதவீதம் சரிந்துள்ளதால், அது முக்கிய $0.50 மட்டத்தைக் கடந்து $0.46 என்ற உள்ளூர் சரிவை எட்டியுள்ளது. சந்தை உணர்வு கரடிச் சந்தை (bearish) நிலைக்கு மாறியுள்ளதால், விலை மேலும் $0.41 ஆதரவுப் பகுதியை நோக்கிச் செல்வதைத் தடுத்து, டிப் பையர்கள் மீட்க உதவுவார்களா என்பதை முதலீட்டாளர்கள் உன்னிப்பாகக் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

It seems like even traditional safe-haven assets like gold are not acting as an inflation hedge. The bond market recently delivered a reminder that inflation hedges can struggle when rising prices
The post Gold and Crypto Fall as Hot US Inflation Rattles Markets appeared first on BeInCrypto.

The latest economic data indicates that traditional safe-haven assets like gold are currently struggling to act as an effective inflation hedge. Broader markets, such as the S&P 500, were also rattled by the rising prices and bond market reactions.
content_ta: அமெரிக்காவின் பணவீக்க புள்ளிவிவரங்கள் எதிர்பார்ப்பை விட அதிகமாக வெளியானதை அடுத்து, Gold மற்றும் Bitcoin உள்ளிட்ட நிதிச் சந்தைகள் சரிவை சந்தித்தன. தங்கம் போன்ற பாரம்பரிய பாதுகாப்பு சொத்துக்களும் கூட தற்போது பணவீக்கத்திற்கு எதிரான பாதுகாப்பாக செயல்பட திணறுவதை சமீபத்திய பொருளாதார தரவுகள் காட்டுகின்றன. S&P 500 போன்ற பரந்த சந்தைகளும் விலையேற்றம் காரணமாக பாதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன.

content_ta: International Atomic Energy Agency ஆனது ஒரு Iranian nuclear site-ல் புதிய கட்டுமானப் பணிகள் நடைபெறுவதை உறுதிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த விரிவுபடுத்துதல் புவிசார் அரசியல் பதட்டங்களை அதிகரிக்கும் என்ற கவலைகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது, இது புதிய தடைகளுக்கு வழிவகுத்து உலகளாவிய எரிசக்தி சந்தைகளையும் பாதிக்கலாம்.

title: ByteDance adapts GRPO for enhanced post-training model capabilities
summary:
ByteDance's adaptation of GRPO for visual generation could revolutionize AI efficiency and quality in multimedia content creation.
The post ByteDance adapts GRPO for enhanced post-training model capabilities appeared first on Crypto Briefing.

title: UK Payments Infrastructure Faces a New Test: Preparing for AI-Driven Payments
summary:
The UK has an opportunity to design its next generation of retail payments infrastructure for an economy where money increasingly moves in real time and around the clock. That means looking beyond how quickly a payment can be initiated and considering whether the infrastructure behind it can support real-time settlement, liquidity and reconciliation as well.
Many payment systems today are only partially real time, combining an instant customer experience with legacy processes behind the scenes. As transaction volumes grow and new payment models emerge, that disconnect will become increasingly difficult to sustain.
The priority should be building a modernisation foundation that gives the UK flexibility to support account-to-account payments, cross-border transactions and emerging forms of digital money without having to redesign the underlying infrastructure for each new use case. At the same time, greater speed cannot come at the expense of resilience. In an always-on payments environment, the infrastructure supporting transactions needs to be just as available, secure and resilient as the services customers see.
The biggest risk is treating these as separate challenges. Infrastructure designed too narrowly for today's payment models will need to be patched as new use cases emerge, and patching creates fragmentation. Fragmentation, in turn, undermines resilience, because complexity is the enemy of availability in an always-on environment. The UK should be most concerned about locking in an architecture that looks modern at launch but cannot evolve without being rebuilt.
For the next generation infrastructure to deliver on that, the final framework needs to set out a clear commitment to real-time gross settlement as the foundation of what comes next. Equally important is interoperability: between domestic payment rails, cross-border systems and emerging forms of digital money. That needs to be designed in from the start, not retrofitted. The UK has a genuine opportunity to make infrastructure choices now that will determine its flexibility for the next decade, and the final report should reflect that ambition.
#PaymentsInfrastructureKanv Pandit, Head of International Markets – Banking and PaymentsHead of International Markets – Fidelity Information Services (FIS)10 Sep, 2026
content: The UK must modernise its retail payments infrastructure to prepare for real-time, AI-driven transactions. Experts warn that combining instant customer experiences with legacy back-end processes creates unsustainable fragmentation and risks resilience. The next-generation framework requires real-time gross settlement, built-in interoperability, and the flexibility to support account-to-account payments, cross-border transfers, and digital money without requiring constant rebuilding.

content: MoneyGram has launched a new Visa stablecoin debit card, following a similar move by its rival Western Union. content_ta: Western Union-ஐ தொடர்ந்து, MoneyGram நிறுவனமும் புதிய Visa stablecoin debit card-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. பிளாக்செயின் அடிப்படையிலான பணப்பரிமாற்ற சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்தும் முயற்சியின் ஒரு பகுதியாக இந்த புதிய அட்டை வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
summary: European finance and tokenization groups say Brussels should remove limits on assets admitted to DLT infrastructure or set a 1.5 trillion euro baseline if a cap remains.
content: European finance and tokenization groups are urging Brussels to remove the current cap on tokenized securities admitted to DLT infrastructure. Alternatively, they suggest establishing a 1.5 trillion euro baseline if any limit must remain. Industry representatives argue that removing these restrictions is essential for fostering innovation and growth within the digital asset sector across the region.
content_ta: ஐரோப்பிய நிதி மற்றும் டோக்கனைசேஷன் அமைப்புகள், DLT உள்கட்டமைப்பில் அனுமதிக்கப்படும் டோக்கனைஸ்டு செக்யூரிட்டிகள் மீதான தற்போதைய உச்சவரம்பை நீக்க வேண்டும் என்று பிரஸ்ஸல்ஸை வலியுறுத்துகின்றன. ஒருவேளை வரம்பு தொடர்ந்தால், 1.5 டிரில்லியன் யூரோ அடிப்படையை நிர்ணயிக்கலாம் என்று அவர்கள் பரிந்துரைக்கின்றனர். பிராந்தியம் முழுவதும் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து துறையில் புதுமை மற்றும் வளர்ச்சியை வளர்ப்பதற்கு இந்த கட்டுப்பாடுகளை அகற்றுவது அவசியம் என்று தொழில் பிரதிநிதிகள் வாதிடுகின்றனர்.

title: This Guy Cloned Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Zuckerberg Into AI Bots. They Immediately Started Fighting
summary: Kun Chen built chatbot versions of four AI CEOs on SpaceXAI's new Grok Bot templates, locked them in one chat, and told them to debate the AI race until they agreed on something.
content: Kun Chen used new Grok Bot templates to create AI chatbot versions of prominent tech leaders, including Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Mark Zuckerberg. After locking the AI avatars into a single chat, Chen instructed them to debate the ongoing artificial intelligence race until they reached a consensus. The experiment immediately resulted in the digital CEOs arguing with one another.
content_ta: Kun Chen தனது புதிய Grok Bot டெம்ப்ளேட்களைப் பயன்படுத்தி Sam Altman, Elon Musk மற்றும் Mark Zuckerberg போன்ற தொழில்நுட்ப தலைவர்களின் AI சாட்பாட் பதிப்புகளை உருவாக்கினார். இந்த AI அவதாரங்களை ஒரே அரட்டையில் பூட்டி, அவை ஒரு உடன்பாட்டுக்கு வரும் வரை விவாதிக்குமாறு அறிவுறுத்தினார். இந்த பரிசோதனையின் விளைவாக, அந்த டிஜிட்டல் CEO-க்கள் உடனடியாகத் தங்களுக்குள் சண்டையிடத் தொடங்கினர்.

title: Anthropic Discloses Fourth Claude Hacking Incident as Debate Around Regulation Grows
summary: The company now says attacks during security tests exposed model behavior failures, after initially emphasizing errors in its testing infrastructure.
content: Anthropic has disclosed a fourth security incident involving its Claude AI model during testing. The company previously attributed earlier issues to testing infrastructure errors, but now acknowledges that the attacks revealed actual failures in model behavior. This latest disclosure adds to ongoing debates and scrutiny surrounding artificial intelligence regulation and safety measures.
content_ta: Anthropic நிறுவனத்தின் Claude AI மாடல் சோதனையின் போது நான்காவது பாதுகாப்பு சம்பவம் நடந்துள்ளதாக அந்நிறுவனம் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. முன்னаர் ஏற்பட்ட சிக்கல்களுக்கு சோதனை உள்கட்டமைப்பு பிழைகளே காரணம் என்று கூறியிருந்த நிறுவனம், தற்போது இந்த தாக்குதல்கள் மாடலின் செயல்பாட்டில் உள்ள உண்மையான குறைபாடுகளை வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளதாக ஒப்புக்கொண்டுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய வெளிப்பாடு செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு ஒழுங்குமுறை மற்றும் பாதுகாப்பு நடவடிக்கைகள் குறித்த விவாதங்களை மேலும் தீவிரப்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: India moves to block 15 crypto apps, leaving users facing sudden account lockout
summary:
App and URL takedown notices raise disruption risks, but completed blocks and withdrawal limits remain unconfirmed.
The post India moves to block 15 crypto apps, leaving users facing sudden account lockout appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: India has taken steps to block 15 crypto apps, raising concerns among users who face potential sudden account lockouts. While app and URL takedown notices present significant disruption risks for traders and investors in the region, the final status of completed blocks and any associated withdrawal limits remain unconfirmed.
content_ta: India-ல் 15 crypto apps-களை block செய்ய நடவடிக்கைகள் எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளதால், பயனர்கள் திடீர் account lockout பிரச்சினைகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் அபாயம் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. App மற்றும் URL takedown notices காரணமாக வர்த்தகர்களுக்கு இடையூறுகள் ஏற்பட வாய்ப்புள்ளதாகவும், முழுமையான block மற்றும் withdrawal limits குறித்த அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தகவல்கள் இன்னும் உறுதிப்படுத்தப்படவில்லை எனவும் கூறப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Top Solana Price Predictions as SOL Bulls Battle to Hold the $100 Line
summary: "SOL is a $500 token trading at $100," X user The Black Bull claimed.
content: Solana bulls are currently fighting to maintain the crucial $100 price support level. Despite recent market fluctuations, supporters remain extremely optimistic about the cryptocurrency's long-term potential. Notably, a prominent social media user known as The Black Bull boldly claimed that SOL is essentially a $500 token currently trading at a heavily discounted price of just $100.
content_ta: Solana பulls தற்போது முக்கிய ஆதரவு நிலையான $100 விலையைப் பாதுகாக்க போராடி வருகின்றனர். சந்தையில் நிலவும் ஏற்றத்தாழ்வுகளுக்கு மத்தியிலும், கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் நீண்டகால எதிர்காலம் குறித்து ஆதரவாளர்கள் மிகவும் நம்பிக்கையுடன் உள்ளனர். குறிப்பாக, The Black Bull என்று அறியப்படும் சமூக வலைதள பயனர் ஒருவர், SOL என்பது உண்மையில் ஒரு $500 டோக்கன் என்றும், அது தற்போது $100 என்ற குறைந்த விலையில் வர்த்தகம் செய்யப்படுவதாகவும் தைரியமாகக் கூறியுள்ளார்.

title: What Will Happen to Bitcoin (BTC) if Trump Distributes $5,000 to Each American: 3 AIs Speculate
summary: "Bitcoin might surge initially, then experience a sharp correction if the bond market or Fed pushed back," ChatGPT predicted.
content: Artificial intelligence models have speculated on the potential impact on Bitcoin if a stimulus of $5,000 were distributed to every American. According to ChatGPT, the cryptocurrency might experience an initial price surge. However, this could be followed by a sharp correction if the bond market or the Federal Reserve pushes back against the policy.
content_ta: அமெரிக்கர்கள் ஒவ்வொருவருக்கும் 5,000 டாலர் ஊக்கத்தொகை வழங்கப்பட்டால் Bitcoin-க்கு என்ன நடக்கும் என்பது குறித்து செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு மாதிரிகள் கணித்துள்ளன. ஆரம்பத்தில் விலை உயரக்கூடும் என்றும், ஆனால் பத்திரச் சந்தையோ அல்லது Federal Reserve அமைப்போ எதிர்த்தால் கடுமையான வீழ்ச்சி ஏற்படலாம் என்றும் ChatGPT கணித்துள்ளது.

title: Why Raydium’s 3.1M transactions matter for RAY’s next breakout
summary: RAY gained 17%, yet sellers kept exiting. Who bought the strength they abandoned?
content: RAY recently saw a 17% price gain alongside 3.1 million transactions on Raydium. Despite this strong upward movement, sellers continued to exit their positions, raising questions about who is buying the strength left behind by departing traders.
content_ta: Raydium-ல் 3.1 மில்லியன் பரிவர்த்தனைகளுடன் RAY விலை हाल-ல் 17% உயர்ந்துள்ளது. இந்த வலுவான விலையேற்றத்திற்கு மத்தியிலும் விற்பனையாளர்கள் தொடர்ந்து வெளியேறி வருகின்றனர், இதனால் விடுபட்ட வர்த்தகர்களின் வலிமையை யார் வாங்குவது என்ற கேள்வி எழுந்துள்ளது.

title: Stellar (XLM) to Power New MoneyGram Stablecoin Visa Card in This Latin American Country
summary: MoneyGram’s new Stellar-powered Visa card brings instant USDC retail checkouts and mobile wallet support to Latin America.
content: MoneyGram is launching a new Visa card powered by the Stellar network in a Latin American country. This integration brings instant USDC retail checkouts and mobile wallet support to users in the region, bridging traditional financial services with blockchain technology.
content_ta: Latin America நா beginning-ல் உள்ள ஒரு நாட்டில் Stellar நெட்வொர்க் மூலம் இயங்கும் புதிய Visa கார்டை MoneyGram அறிமுகப்படுத்துகிறது. இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு இப்பகுதியில் உள்ள பயனர்களுக்கு உடனடி USDC சில்லறை விற்பனை சோதனைகள் மற்றும் மொபைல் வாலட் ஆதரவைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது.

title: XRP Healthcare Goes Offline After Top Ex-Ripple Engineers Call Out 'Red Flags'
summary: XRP Healthcare shuts down after ex-Ripple devs validate years of red flags and comment on a critical $452,000 wallet security vulnerability.
content: XRP Healthcare has taken its platform offline following public scrutiny from former Ripple engineers. These developers pointed out serious warning signs, including a critical security vulnerability involving a $452,000 wallet. The shutdown marks a sudden halt for the project after years of lingering concerns raised by industry experts regarding its operations and security practices.
content_ta: முன்னாள் Ripple இன்ஜினியர்களின் கடுமையான எச்சரிக்கைகளை அடுத்து XRP Healthcare தனது சேவைகளை தற்காலிகமாக நிறுத்தியுள்ளது. $452,000 மதிப்புள்ள வாலட் பாதுகாப்பு குறைபாடு உட்பட பல முக்கிய பிரச்சினைகளை டெவலப்பர்கள் சுட்டிக்காட்டியுள்ளனர். இந்த திடீர் முடக்கம் இத்துறை வட்டாரத்தில் பெரும் பரபரப்பை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: The US Dollar Is Stuck. Americans Could Feel the Pain Soon
summary:
The Dollar Index holds 99 as a hawkish Fed collides with ECB hikes and yen intervention. Two levels decide the trend.

content: The US Dollar Index is holding steady near 99 amidst competing pressures from a hawkish Federal Reserve, European Central Bank rate hikes, and yen intervention. Analysts note that two critical technical levels will determine the currency's upcoming trend. If the dollar experiences a significant shift, everyday Americans could soon feel the economic impact in their daily lives and purchasing power.
content_ta: US Dollar Index ஆனது hawkish Fed, ECB மற்றும் yen intervention ஆகியவற்றின் அழுத்தங்களுக்கு மத்தியில் 99 என்ற அளவில் உறுதியாக உள்ளது. இரண்டு முக்கிய நிலைகள் இதன் போrok-ஐ தீர்மானிக்கும் என்று ஆய்வாளர்கள் கூறுகின்றனர். டாலரில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க மாற்றம் ஏற்பட்டால், சாதாரண Americans விரைவில் பொருளாதார தாக்கத்தை உணரக்கூடும்.

title: Ethereum Exchange Supply Falls to 15.5M ETH as On-Chain Momentum Turns Bullish
summary:
Ethereum exchange supply hits a multi-year low as MVRV momentum turns bullish and ETH defends $2,438.
The post Ethereum Exchange Supply Falls to 15.5M ETH as On-Chain Momentum Turns Bullish appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Ethereum exchange supply has dropped to 15.5 million ETH, reaching a multi-year low. This decline coincides with on-chain momentum turning bullish, particularly as market metrics like MVRV improve and ETH successfully defends key support levels near $2,438, signaling potential positive price movement ahead for the cryptocurrency.
content_ta: Ethereum பரிமாற்ற சப்ளை 15.5 மில்லியன் ETH ஆகக் குறைந்துள்ளது, இது பல ஆண்டுகால சரிவாகும். MVRV மொமெண்டம் சாதகமாக மாறுவதாலும், ETH $2,438 ஆதரவு நிலையை வெற்றிகரமாகப் பாதுகாப்பதாலும் இந்த ஆன்-சயின் மாற்றங்கள் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளன.

title: OPEC slashes 2026 oil demand growth forecast for fifth straight month
summary:
OPEC's repeated demand forecast cuts highlight the volatility in global oil markets, potentially undermining confidence in future projections.
The post OPEC slashes 2026 oil demand growth forecast for fifth straight month appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OPEC has reduced its 2026 oil demand growth forecast for the fifth consecutive month. This repeated downward revision underscores ongoing volatility in global energy markets and reflects growing uncertainty regarding future consumption trends. Such adjustments may impact market confidence and influence broader economic projections across the energy sector.
content_ta: தொடர்ச்சியாக ஐந்தாவது மாதமாக தனது 2026 ஆம் ஆண்டுக்கான எண்ணெய் தேவை வளர்ச்சி குறித்த கணிப்பை OPEC குறைத்துள்ளது. உலகளாவிய எரிசக்தி சந்தைகளில் நிலவும் தொடர் ஏற்ற இறக்கங்களை இந்தத் தொடர் திருத்தங்கள் அடிக்கோடிட்டுக் காட்டுகின்றன. எதிர்கால நுகர்வுப் போக்குகள் குறித்த நிச்சயமற்ற தன்மையையும் இது வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது.

title: McKinsey report reveals wealth growth outpaces real economy in 2025
summary:
The report highlights potential economic instability and inequality as wealth growth increasingly relies on asset inflation rather than real output.
The post McKinsey report reveals wealth growth outpaces real economy in 2025 appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A recent McKinsey report reveals that global wealth growth outpaced the real economy in 2025. content: Uniswap whale accumulation has continued to grow despite recent market corrections, as the Fibonacci golden zone emerged as a critical support level. Investors and market watchers are now watching closely to see if UNI bulls can successfully mount a recovery and reclaim the $7.48 price level amidst ongoing volatility.
content_ta: சந்தை சரிவு ஏற்பட்ட போதிலும், UNI வேல்ஸ் எனப்படும் பெரிய முதலீட்டாளர்களின் சேமிப்பு தொடர்ந்து அதிகரித்து வருகிறது. ஃபைப் பினோச்சி கோல்டன் பகுதி முக்கிய ஆதரவு நிலையாக உருவெடுத்துள்ளதால், UNI காப்பாளர்கள் மீண்டும் $7.48 விலையை மீட்டெடுக்க முடியுமா என்ற எதிர்பார்ப்பு சந்தையில் எழுந்துள்ளது.

title: Nuclear stocks slide as Piper Sandler splits the sector with divergent ratings
summary:
Analyst divergence highlights the volatility and uncertainty in nuclear sector investments, impacting investor confidence and market stability.
The post Nuclear stocks slide as Piper Sandler splits the sector with divergent ratings appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Nuclear stocks experienced a decline after Piper Sandler issued divergent ratings for companies within the sector. This analyst split underscores the ongoing volatility and uncertainty surrounding investments in nuclear energy, which has consequently impacted overall investor confidence and market stability.
content_ta: Piper Sandler நிறுவனம் nuclear துறையைச் சேர்ந்த நிறுவனங்களுக்கு மாறுபட்ட மதிப்பீடுகளை வழங்கியதை அடுத்து, nuclear stocks சரிவைச் சந்தித்தன. இந்த ஆய்வாளர் கருத்து வேறுபாடு, nuclear energy முதலீடுகளில் நிலவும் நிலையற்ற தன்மையையும் நிச்சயமற்ற தன்மையையும் வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது, இது முதலீட்டாளர்களின் நம்பிக்கையையும் சந்தை ஸ்திரத்தன்மையையும் பாதித்துள்ளது.

title: Payments Fraud is an Identity Problem, Not a Transaction Problem
summary:
Payments firms spend billions watching what users do once inside the system. DCG chief technology officer Paul Twigg says the real gap is knowing who they are.
The post Payments Fraud is an Identity Problem, Not a Transaction Problem appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Payments companies currently spend billions of dollars monitoring user activity within their systems. However, DCG chief technology officer Paul Twigg argues that the primary issue is not transaction behavior, but rather identity verification. According to Twigg, the real gap in preventing payments fraud lies in accurately knowing the identities of the users before they enter the system.
content_ta: பெமண்ட்ஸ் நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் சிஸ்டம்க içல் பயனர்களின் நடவடிக்கைகளைக் கண்காணிக்க பல பில்லியன் டாலர்களைச் செலவிடுகின்றன. எவ்வாறாயினும், பரிவர்த்தனை நடத்தை அல்ல, மாறாக அடையாளம் காண்பதுதான் உண்மையான சிக்கல் என்று DCG chief technology officer Paul Twigg வாதிடுகிறார். Twigg-இன் கூற்றுப்படி, பெமண்ட்ஸ் மோசடியைத் தடுப்பதில் உள்ள உண்மையான இடைவெளி, பயனர்கள் சிஸ்டமிற்குள் நுழைவதற்கு முன்பு அவர்களின் அடையாளங்களைத் துல்லியமாக அறிந்துகொள்வதில்தான் உள்ளது.

title: Why a new SEC plan could ease a legal headache for tokenized securities
summary: The SEC's new proposal to overhaul transfer-agent rules could eliminate duplicate offchain shareholder records, reducing reconciliation costs and legal uncertainty for tokenized securities.
content: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has introduced a new proposal to overhaul transfer-agent rules. This plan could eliminate duplicate offchain shareholder records, which would help reduce reconciliation costs and legal uncertainty for tokenized securities.
content_ta: SEC-ன் புதிய பரிந்துரை, transfer-agent விதிகளில் மாற்றங்களை கொண்டுவருகிறது. இந்த திட்டம் offchain பங்குதாரர் பதிவுகளை நீக்குவதன் மூலம், tokenized securities-களுக்கான செலவுகளைக் குறைக்க உதவும்.

title: Coinbase Wallet Rebrands to Chase 'Anything, Anywhere' Trading as Robinhood Chain Heats Up
summary: Head of Product Ryan Kass says the return to Coinbase Wallet reflects a broader trading strategy, with the self-custody app serving as a testing ground for new assets and experiences.
content: Coinbase Wallet has rebranded its focus toward versatile trading as competition heats up with rivals like Robinhood. According to Head of Product Ryan Kass, this strategy positions the self-custody app as a key testing ground for new digital assets and user experiences, reflecting a broader push in the crypto trading landscape.
content_ta: Coinbase Wallet தனது வர்த்தக உத்தியை மாற்றி அமைத்துள்ளது. Robinhood போன்ற நிறுவனங்களுடன் போட்டி அதிகரித்து வரும் நிலையில், புதிய டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்கள் மற்றும் பயனர் அனுபவங்களைச் சோதித்துப் பார்க்கும் முக்கிய தளமாக இந்த சுய-பாதுகாப்பு செயலி செயல்படும் என்று ஹெட் ஆஃப் ப்ராடக்ட் Ryan Kass தெரிவித்தார்.

title: Bitcoin Rally Cools, But a Golden Cross Is Coming
summary: Bitcoin couldn't escape today's inflation-driven selloff, but a bearish pattern on its chart is about to flip for the first time since November.
content: Bitcoin's recent price rally cooled down as the cryptocurrency failed to escape a broader inflation-driven market selloff. Despite the downward pressure, technical analysts are eyeing an upcoming golden cross, a bullish chart pattern that is set to flip for the first time since November, offering a glimmer of hope for investors amid ongoing economic uncertainty.
content_ta: பணவீக்கம் காரணமாக சந்தையில் ஏற்பட்ட சரிவிலிருந்து தப்பிக்கத் தவறியதால் Bitcoin-ன் விலை உயர்வு சற்று தணிந்துள்ளது. இருப்பினும், தொடர்ந்து நிலவும் பொருளாதார நிச்சயமற்ற தன்மையிலும் முதலீட்டாளர்களுக்கு நம்பிக்கை அளிக்கும் வகையில், வரவிருக்கும் தொழில்நுட்ப விளக்கப்படம் தொடர்பான தங்க குறுக்குவெட்டு (golden cross) கடந்த நவம்பருக்குப் பிறகு முதல்முறையாக மாறத் தயாராக உள்ளது.

title: Banks Have Minutes, Not Weeks, to Fix Flaws as AI Speeds Up Attacks: BIS
summary: The Bank for International Settlements says routine patching schedules are increasingly inadequate and cites guidance urging banks to accept planned downtime for urgent fixes.
content: The Bank for International Settlements warns that financial institutions now have very little time to fix security flaws as artificial intelligence accelerates cyberattacks. According to the BIS, traditional routine patching schedules are no longer sufficient. The organization urges banks to embrace planned system downtime to implement urgent security fixes quickly and protect against fast-moving threats.
content_ta: செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு காரணமாக சைபர் தாக்குதல்கள் வேகமாக அதிகரித்து வருவதால், வங்கிகள் பாதுகாப்பு குறைபாடுகளை சரிசெய்ய சில வாரங்கள் அல்ல, சில நிமிடங்களே அவகாசம் கொண்டுள்ளதாக BIS எச்சரித்துள்ளது. வழக்கமான பேட்சிங் முறைகள் இனி போதாது என்று கூறியுள்ள BIS, அவசர திருத்தங்களை உடնடியாக மேற்கொள்ள திட்டமிடப்பட்ட சிஸ்டம் டவுன்டைமை வங்கிகள் ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள வேண்டும் என்று வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Visa’s $2.5 billion crypto credit bet puts card settlement financing onchain
summary:
Private Visa files size the loans, smart contracts collect repayment, and undisclosed terms determine who takes the first loss.
The post Visa’s $2.5 billion crypto credit bet puts card settlement financing onchain appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Visa is advancing a crypto credit initiative valued at $2.5 billion, moving card settlement financing on-chain. Under this system, private files size the loans while smart contracts handle repayment. Undisclosed terms determine risk distribution and first-loss responsibility for the financing arrangements.
content_ta: Visa நிறுவனத்தின் $2.5 பில்லியன் கிரிப்டோ கிரெடிட் திட்டம் மூலம் கார்டு செட்டில்மென்ட் ஃபைனான்சிங் ஆன்-சேனுக்கு கொண்டுவரப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த அமைப்பில், ஸ்மார்ட் காண்ட்ராக்ட்கள் திருப்பிச் செலுத்துதலை நிர்வகிக்கின்றன, மேலும் கடன்களின் அளவை பிரைவேட் ஃபைல்கள் தீர்மானிக்கின்றன.

title: Wall Street’s altcoin ETF rotation is not producing an altseason, and the old playbook may be breaking
summary:
Regulated funds can concentrate demand in Ethereum and Solana while broad altcoin leadership remains absent.
The post Wall Street’s altcoin ETF rotation is not producing an altseason, and the old playbook may be breaking appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Recent financial activity on Wall Street shows a rotation into altcoin ETFs focusing on major assets like Ethereum and Solana. However, this shift is failing to trigger a broader altseason. Market analysts observe that the traditional playbook for crypto market cycles may be breaking, as regulated funds concentrate demand rather than spreading capital widely across the altcoin sector.
content_ta: Wall Street-ல் altcoin ETF-களில் முதலீடுகள் Ethereum மற்றும் Solana போன்ற முக்கிய சொத்துக்களின் பக்கம் திரும்பியுள்ளன. இருப்பினும், இந்த மாற்றம் பரந்த அளவிலான altseason-ஐ உருவாக்கத் தவறிவிட்டது. ஒழுங்குபடுத்தப்பட்ட நிதிகள் தேவையை குறிப்பிட்ட சில சொத்துக்களில் மட்டுமே குவிப்பதால், கிரிப்டோ சந்தை சுழற்சிகளுக்கான பழைய வழிகள் உடைந்து வருவதாக சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: XRP Price Prediction: Bearish Futures Data Casts Doubt on XRP’s Recovery
summary:
XRP slips to $1.38 as negative funding rates and a sub-1 long-short ratio raise doubts about its recovery. Key levels and scenarios inside.
The post XRP Price Prediction: Bearish Futures Data Casts Doubt on XRP’s Recovery appeared first on Cryptonews.
content: XRP recently slipped to $1.38, facing downward pressure as bearish futures data raises doubts about a potential recovery. Negative funding rates and a long-short ratio below one indicate growing caution among traders regarding the cryptocurrency's short-term market trajectory.
content_ta: எஆர்பி (XRP) விலை சமீபத்தில் 1.38 டாலராகக் குறைந்துள்ளது. கரடி சந்தை (bearish) எதிர்கால தரவுகள் அதன் மீட்சியின் மீது சந்தேகத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளதால், அது கீழ்நோக்கிய அழுத்தத்தை எதிர்கொள்கிறது. எதிர்மறை நிதி விகிதங்கள் மற்றும் ஒன்றுக்கும் குறைவான லாங்-ஷார்ட் விகிதம் ஆகியவை கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் குறுகிய கால சந்தைப் பாதை குறித்து வர்த்தகர்கள் மத்தியில் அதிகரித்து வரும் எச்சரிக்கையைக் குறிக்கின்றன.

title: Aerodrome locks 171K AERO amid price drop – Can buybacks help bulls?
summary: Decoding why Aerodrome's 10% loss could be the end of its correction.
content: Aerodrome recently locked 171,000 AERO tokens amid a notable price drop of about 10 percent. Market analysts are questioning whether upcoming buybacks can assist the bulls in recovering these losses and halting the current market correction phase for the asset.
content_ta: Aerodrome சமீபத்தில் 171,000 AERO டோக்கன்களை லாக் செய்துள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில் இதன் விலை சுமார் 10 சதவீதம் வரை சரிந்துள்ளது. வரவிருக்கும் பைபேக்ஸ் மூலம் சந்தையில் காளைகள் மீண்டும் எழுச்சி பெற்று இந்த சரிவைத் தடுக்க முடியுமா என்ற கேள்வியை சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்கள் எழுப்புகின்றனர்.

title: Kraken’s kHYPE expands Hyperliquid utility – Whale stakes entire $159M position
summary: HYPE gains support from Kraken and whale staking.
content: Kraken has expanded the utility of Hyperliquid through its kHYPE offering. Following this development, a prominent whale has staked an entire $159 million position, highlighting strong market confidence and increasing adoption and support for HYPE within the broader digital asset ecosystem.
content_ta: Kraken தனது kHYPE வழங்குதல் மூலம் Hyperliquid-ன் பயன்பாட்டை விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த வளர்ச்சியினைத் தொடர்ந்து, ஒரு முக்கிய whale தனது முழு $159 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான பங்கை ஸ்டேக் செய்துள்ளார். இது HYPE மீதான வலுவான சந்தை நம்பிக்கையையும், பரந்த டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பில் அதன் ஆதரவு அதிகரிப்பதையும் காட்டுகிறது.

title: BNB price falls 6% in two sessions as $700 support comes into view
summary: BNB has retreated from around $757 to $710 as wider market pressure tests whether buyers can defend the $700 area.
content: The price of BNB has declined by six percent over two consecutive trading sessions, retreating from approximately $757 down to $710. This downward movement comes amid broader market pressure, as traders and analysts closely monitor whether buyers will successfully step in to defend the critical $700 support level.
content_ta: இரண்டு தொடர்ச்சியான வர்த்தக அமர்வுகளில் BNB விலை ஆறு சதவீதம் சரிந்து, தோராயமாக $757-ல் இருந்து $710 ஆகக் குறைந்துள்ளது. பரந்த சந்தை அழுத்தத்திற்கு மத்தியில் இந்த விலை சரிவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது, மேலும் வாங்குபவர்கள் முக்கியமான $700 ஆதரவு நிலையை வெற்றிகரமாகப் பாதுகாப்பார்களா என்பதை வர்த்தகர்கள் உன்னிப்பாகக் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Ripple Burns 15 Million RLUSD in Major Treasury Move
summary: Ripple has burned 15 million RLUSD in its latest major treasury move, even as the stablecoin’s market capitalization continues to surge toward new highs.
content: Ripple has executed a major treasury move by burning 15 million RLUSD tokens. This significant token burn occurs while the stablecoin's market capitalization continues to experience a strong surge, reaching new highs as adoption and activity around the asset grow within the broader digital asset ecosystem.
content_ta: Ripple நிறுவனம் தனது முக்கிய டூசுரி நடவடிக்கையாக 15 மில்லியன் RLUSD டோக்கன்களை அழித்துள்ளது. ஸ்டேபிள்காயினின் சந்தை மூலதனம் புதிய உச்சங்களை நோக்கி தொடர்ந்து உயர்ந்து வரும் வேளையில் இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: ECB Hikes Rates to 2.5%, But Euro Stablecoins Still Pay Zero
summary:
The ECB raised its deposit rate to 2.50%. MiCA bars euro stablecoin issuers from paying interest to holders.
The post ECB Hikes Rates to 2.5%, But Euro Stablecoins Still Pay Zero appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: The European Central Bank has raised its deposit rate to 2.50%. Despite the rate hike, holders of euro stablecoins continue to receive zero interest. This situation persists because the Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation, known as MiCA, legally bars euro stablecoin issuers from paying interest to their token holders.
content_ta: ஐரோப்பிய மத்திய வங்கியான ECB தனது வைப்புத்தொகை வட்டியை 2.50% ஆக உயர்த்தியுள்ளது. இந்த வட்டி உயர்வு இருந்தபோதிலும், யூரோ stablecoins வைத்திருப்பவர்களுக்கு தொடர்ந்தும் வட்டி வழங்கப்படவில்லை. MiCA ஒழுங்குமுறை விதிகளின்படி, யூரோ stablecoin வெளியிடுபவர்கள் தங்கள் டோக்கன் வைப்பவர்களுக்கு வட்டி வழங்குவதை சட்டம் தடை செய்கிறது.

title: Altera prepares IPO with Silver Lake backing, could raise over $2B
summary:

content_ta: Los Angeles-ல் உள்ள Skid Row பகுதியில் வசிக்கும் நபர்களுக்கு பணம் கொடுத்து, வாக்காளர்களின் திருடப்பட்ட அடையாளங்களைப் பயன்படுத்தி வாக்குச்சீட்டு மனுக்களில் போலிக் கையெழுத்திடச் செய்ததாக Victorville-ஐச் சேர்ந்த ஒருவரும் அவரது இரண்டு கூட்டாளிகளும் பெடரல் அதிகாரிகளால் குற்றம் சாட்டப்பட்டுள்ளனர். 2026 பிப்ரவரி முதல் ஆகஸ்ட் வரை நடைபெற்ற இந்த மோசடி மூலம் முக்கிய நபர் சுமார் $41,600 லாபம் ஈட்டியுள்ளார்.
